scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.copyFileSync('manifest.json', 'dist/manifest.json'); const contentPath = 'dist/content.js'; const content = fs.readFileSync(contentPath, 'utf8').replace(/\r?\nexport \{\};\s*$/u, '\n'); fs.writeFileSync(contentPath, content);"
